About Wendt Woodworks

Wendt Woodworks is a one-man side shop. Every planter is built by hand for a local client — measured for their space, cut and assembled in the shop, and finished the way they picked it.

It started with raised beds for neighbors' gardens and grew by word of mouth. There's no warehouse and no inventory: your planter doesn't exist until you order it, and it's built one at a time, to order.

  • Built by: One builder, start to finish
  • For: Local clients — delivery or pickup
  • How to order: Build yours, then request a quote
